why: FORGE-142 (A defect in a dependency is fixed in the dependency, by a patch the archetype carries and applies at every install until the dependency releases the fix; the first is Quasar's queued focus). A focus Quasar queues while a popup is in transition runs when the transition ends, whatever has been focused since, so a select whose option is picked while its menu opens takes focus back about 300 ms after the menu closes, and the next field loses what is typed. Measured 2026-11-13 on Quasar 2.33.2 and 2.35.0; 2.35.4 has the same code. Retire once the test passes without it.
